as_told.title: Eastern Seaboard objects possibly doing reconnaissance

plain: In 2014 and 2015, Navy fighter jets training in a big block of sky off Virginia Beach on the US East Coast picked up round objects nearly every day, says Ryan Graves, a fighter pilot who flew there. He says the objects showed up once their jets got a newer radar, and that the radar, a camera pod used for aiming, and the seeker head of a heat-seeking missile all detected the same things, which told them a physical object was there. Graves says they did not assume these were UFOs and wondered if a foreign adversary was spying by soaking up their radar signals, and another guest, Marik von Rennenkampff, repeats his account.
